title: Accounts and Business Advisory Associate
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a highly respected Top 10 accountancy practice in Norwich. Working with a diverse portfolio of owner-managed businesses, SMEs and growing organisations, you'll become part of a collaborative and supportive team that invests heavily in the development of its people.
Your new role
As an Accounts & Business Advisory Associate, you will play a key role in delivering accounting and advisory services to a varied client portfolio. Working closely with senior team members, you will gain exposure to a broad range of assignments while building strong client relationships.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Preparing statutory accounts for a variety of clients, including limited companies, partnerships and sole traders.
- Assisting with management accounts and financial reporting assignments.
- Preparing corporation tax computations and returns.
- Supporting senior colleagues on advisory projects and client engagements.
- Liaising directly with clients to gather information and resolve queries.
- Ensuring assignments are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships through excellent service delivery.
- Supporting junior team members where required and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

What you'll need to succeed
- Experience working within an accountancy practice environment.
- AAT qualified, ACA/ACCA part-qualified, or studying towards a professional qualification.
- Experience preparing accounts for a range of clients.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- A proactive attitude and desire to develop a long-term career within practice.

What you'll get in return
- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
- Full study support (where applicable).
- Clear progression opportunities within a nationally recognised firm.
- Exposure to a broad and interesting client portfolio.
- Ongoing technical and professional development.
- Enhanced annual leave.
- Pension scheme.
- Employee assistance programme.
- Wellbeing initiatives and employee benefits platform.
- A supportive and inclusive team culture.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT
NORWICH (HYBRID AFTER PROBATION)
UP TO £32,500

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're recruiting on behalf of an established retail business that is looking for an Accounts Assistant to join its busy finance team. This newly created position follows continued business growth and internal promotions.

Working closely with the Management Accountants, you'll support the preparation of monthly management accounts and manufacturer reporting, while providing financial information to senior managers and stakeholders.

This is an opportunity for someone with experience in an accounts department who is keen to develop their management accounting skills and take on a varied role within a supportive team.

THE ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Supporting the preparation of monthly management accounts.
- Assisting with month-end processes, including accruals and prepayments.
- Completing balance sheet reconciliations, providing commentary and following up outstanding items.
- Authorising daily payments in line with company procedures.
- Processing manufacturer bonuses on a weekly basis.
- Monitoring outstanding debts, chasing overdue balances and reporting on ageing debt.
- Responding to queries from management and explaining information within the management accounts.
- Supporting stock takes, performing variance analysis and investigating causes.
- Working alongside Senior Accountants to identify improvements to financial processes and operational procedures.
- Highlighting discrepancies, financial control concerns and any suspected fraudulent activity.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation in accordance with company procedures and legal requirements.

THE PERSON:
- AAT Level 3 qualified or equivalent; candidates qualified by experience will also be considered.
- Previous experience within a busy accounts department.
- Confident using Microsoft Office packages, including Excel.
- Knowledge of Pinnacle DMS would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Previous retail or motor trade experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

TO APPLY:
Please send your CV for the Accounts Assistant role via the advert for immediate consideration.

title: Accounts Receivable Clerk - Part-Time
description:

Location: Norwich,

Hours: 3 full days per week (office-based)

About the Role

Keeler Recruitment is delighted to be working exclusively with an established Norwich-based business seeking a reliable and organised Accounts Receivable Clerk to join their finance team on a part-time basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous accounts receivable or general finance administration experience who is looking for a role within a friendly and supportive working environment.

title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Client Bookkeeper

Norwich £28,000 to £34,000 Full-time, permanent Hybrid after probation

If you're the bookkeeper people come to when something doesn't add up, and you'd rather build smarter ways of working than do things the way they've always been done, read on.

This is a bookkeeping and client-focused role with a modern Norwich practice. You'll keep the bookkeeping running smoothly, review other people's work and produce VAT, MTD and possibly management accounts, with AI tools to help you work faster.

THE FIRM

An independent, cloud-based accountancy practice in Norwich with a clear purpose: to make accounting a genuine partnership for small businesses, not a black box. The client base is varied and interesting, from owner-managed businesses and entrepreneurs to charities and social enterprises.

They use AI tools properly (with a human always checking the output), the leadership team are serious about training and technical standards, and the culture puts wellbeing and development front and centre.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Running the day-to-day bookkeeping and reporting planner, so work flows and deadlines are hit
- Reviewing junior colleagues' bookkeeping, spotting patterns and training errors out rather than quietly fixing them
- Preparing and submitting VAT and MTD returns
- Processing and reviewing bookkeeping in Dext, FreeAgent, Xero and QuickBooks
- Using AI to speed up file reviews, draft client queries and pull insight from the numbers
- Spotting bottlenecks and clearing them, rather than letting queries sit

WHO THIS WILL SUIT
- AAT or ICB qualified (MICB or FICB), or strong QBE
- At least 3 years' multi-client experience in UK accountancy practice
- Confident with VAT, MTD and management accounts
- Genuinely tech-savvy and keen on AI and automation
- Unafraid of change and happy to rethink how things are done
- Someone who drives work forward and enjoys helping others improve

WHAT'S ON OFFER
- £28,000 to £34,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working once you've passed probation
- Fully funded private healthcare, an Employee Assistance Programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders
- Profit-share bonus and pension
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Support with further study if you want to progress
- A green, easy-to-reach office with a cycle to work scheme

INTERESTED?

Give me a call or send your CV for a confidential chat. Nothing goes to the firm without your say-so.

Know someone who'd be perfect for this? If I place them, I'll send you £250 in John Lewis vouchers as a thank you.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Big Sky Additions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are recruiting a Finance Assistant to join a busy and supportive finance team based in Norwich.

This is a great opportunity for someone with Purchase Ledger or Accounts Payable experience who is looking for a varied role offering responsibility for their own supplier accounts and exposure to wider finance processes.

You'll work closely with colleagues across finance, purchasing and operational teams, combining day-to-day invoice processing with reconciliations, subcontractor payments and query resolution.

What You'll Be Doing
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and goods received.
- Coding costs accurately to contracts and relevant cost codes.
- Managing your own portfolio of supplier accounts.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Resolving invoice and payment queries with suppliers and internal teams.
- Reviewing and processing subcontractor payment information.
- Preparing subcontractor payment runs.
- Ensuring invoices and payments meet internal controls and procedures.
- Supporting the wider finance team when required.

What We're Looking For

You'll already have experience within Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable or a similar finance role and be comfortable working in a busy environment.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Good experience processing invoices and reconciling supplier accounts.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to organise and prioritise your own workload.
- Confidence investigating discrepancies and resolving queries.
- Good communication skills when dealing with suppliers and colleagues.
- Competence with Excel and accounting systems.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Knowledge of CIS, VAT or subcontractor payments would be advantageous, as would experience within construction or another project-led environment.

What's on Offer?

A varied Finance Assistant position within a friendly and experienced team, offering the opportunity to take ownership of your workload and broaden your accounts experience.

Please apply online or contact Justin Murray at Big Sky Additions for a confidential chat.

title: Management Accounts Assistant
description:
Join Newsquest, one of the UK's largest and most successful local media organisations, reaching millions of readers every month through our trusted newspapers, websites and digital marketing solutions. As part of our Finance team, you'll play a key role in supporting the delivery of accurate financial reporting, forecasting and analysis that helps drive business performance across the organisation.

Reporting to the Financial Controller and working within a wider finance function, you'll assist in the production of management information, provide valuable insight into financial performance, and support operational managers in achieving business objectives while maintaining robust financial controls.

This is a hybrid role, with travel to our Norwich office as and when required. We also have offices in Basildon, Colchester and Ipswich, which may provide additional flexibility depending on your location and business requirements. In addition, we have a Central London office in Holborn, where occasional team or business meetings may be held, requiring infrequent travel as needed.

This opportunity would suit an ambitious finance professional who enjoys working collaboratively, analysing financial data, influencing decision-making and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within a dynamic and evolving business.

Key Responsibilities

Management Accounting & Reporting
- Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and cost reallocations.
- Support the production of monthly management accounts and associated commentary.
- Prepare reporting packs and key performance indicators for management review.
- Complete detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast and prior year performance.
- Assist with year-end schedules, reconciliations and audit requirements.

Forecasting, Budgeting & Analysis
- Prepare weekly profit forecasts using submissions from Commercial Directors and operational teams.
- Review financial submissions, challenge assumptions where appropriate and investigate variances.
- Support the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts.
- Maintain forecasting and budgeting models.
- Analyse trends and provide meaningful insight into financial and operational performance.
- Assist budget holders with forecasting, planning and cost management activities.

Business Partnering & Commercial Support
- Build strong relationships with managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Support operational teams by providing timely and accurate financial information.
- Develop a detailed understanding of departmental and operational cost drivers.
- Monitor costs and identify unusual movements, trends and opportunities for improvement.
- Produce regular and ad hoc reporting to support business decision-making.

Controls, Compliance & Governance
- Ensure financial records are maintained in line with company policies and accounting standards.
- Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, resolving outstanding items promptly.
- Support internal and external audit requirements.
- Help maintain strong financial controls and governance processes.
- Identify areas of risk and recommend improvements to controls and procedures.
- Ensure reporting deadlines are consistently achieved with a high degree of accuracy.

Process Improvement & Team Support
- Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy and automation.
- Support the implementation of new systems and reporting tools.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the finance function.
- Assist in the development of standard operating procedures and process documentation.
- Provide support to colleagues within the wider finance team.
- Undertake ad hoc projects, analysis and reporting as required.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Essential
- Part-qualified (ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) or qualified by experience.
- Previous experience working within a management accounting or assistant accountant role.
- Strong understanding of month-end processes, journals, accruals, prepayments and reconciliations.
- Experience producing management information, financial analysis and reporting.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
- Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of data.
- Ability to interpret financial information and communicate findings clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Proactive and collaborative approach with excellent communication skills.

Desirable
- Experience working within a multi-site or fast-paced commercial environment.
- Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
- Experience supporting audits and maintaining financial controls.
- Exposure to reporting systems and finance automation projects.
- Experience using ERP or finance systems such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite or similar.

Personal Attributes
- Commercially aware and driven to understand business performance.
- Curious, inquisitive and confident challenging assumptions.
- Adaptable and comfortable working in a changing environment.
- Team-oriented with a positive and professional attitude.
- Committed to continuous learning and personal development.

If you're looking to develop your finance career within a well-established, forward-thinking media business where your work will directly influence decision-making and performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays + your birthday off
- Holiday buy scheme for extra flexibility
- Structured career progression & ongoing training
- Pension plan
- Employee Helpline counselling and advice
- Perks & discounts including:
- Gym membership
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Eye care
- Retail discounts
- Team building days & annual volunteer charity day

title: Payroll & HR Coordinator
description:
Are you a detail-driven Payroll professional looking to grow your HR experience? Join our dynamic retail team as a Payroll & HR Coordinator where you'll not only ensure people are paid accurately and on time but also play a key role in supporting the wider HR function.

About the Role

As a payroll coordinator, you'll take ownership of processing for stores and head office teams. You'll also get hands-on exposure to a variety of HR duties - from onboarding and employee record management to supporting day-to-day HR queries. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to develop a broader career in HR within a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Process payroll accurately and on schedule for all employees.
- Manage payroll changes including new starters, leavers, and contract amendments.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC legislation, pensions, and statutory payments.
- Reconcile payroll reports and liaise with Finance for payment approvals.
- Maintain employee records in the HRIS and ensure data accuracy.
- Support HR with recruitment administration, onboarding, and absence tracking.
- Assist with HR projects and employee engagement initiatives.

What You'll Bring
- Previous experience in payroll administration
- Pensions experience (desirable)
- A good understanding of payroll legislation and best practice.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Proficiency in MS Excel
- A proactive approach and willingness to get involved in broader HR activities.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for training and career development in both Payroll and HR.
- A friendly, supportive team culture within a growing retail brand.
